node.title: MCA rank-two large-clone Pade obstruction router
node.closure: exact division obstruction and doubled-denominator owner reduction
node.statement: In the moving-denominator rank-two branch of the large-clone Mobius normal form, write Qhat=q0+gamma q1 and Nhat=p0+gamma p1+gamma^2 p2. The polynomial Omega=q1^2 p0-q0 q1 p1+q0^2 p2 vanishes at every clone coordinate and has degree at most m+2d. If the clone size exceeds m+2d, Omega is identically zero and the whole split pencil equals one fixed affine-in-slope rational owner with reduced denominator degree at most 2d. At clone size exactly m+2d, Omega is either zero or a scalar multiple of the clone locator. Thus the genuinely moving rank-two residual is confined to m<=c<=m+2d, with exact deployed upper walls 1250992 and 1250920, or routes to a fixed doubled-denominator owner; no row-sharp payment for those residuals is claimed.
